about.scrollTitle: Building Earth Intelligence. Enabling Tech Sovereignty.
about.title: Unifying Multi-Modal Earth Data
about.paragraph1: Harvest Global SSP Pvt Ltd (HG Systems) is pioneering Earth Intelligence by integrating multi-spectral satellite imagery, weather streams, and ground-truth sensor networks into an enterprise-grade GeoAI stack.
about.paragraph2: We build foundational AI models and sovereign cloud infrastructure empowering governments, insurance providers, and global enterprises to address climate resilience, agriculture risk, and spatial governance.

title: Unified GeoAI Stack &
Sovereign Infrastructure.
technology.description: An end-to-end Earth Intelligence architecture bridging satellite data ingestion, foundation model training, real-time edge processing, and strategic decision delivery.

stages.label: STAGE 01
stages.title: L0 Multi-Sensor Ingestion
stages.description: Continuous streams of optical, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), thermal, and meteorological earth observation data.

stages.label: STAGE 02
stages.title: Geo Foundation Models
stages.description: Proprietary multi-modal AI transformers optimized for spatio-temporal dynamics and environmental analysis.

stages.label: STAGE 03
stages.title: Sovereign Private Cloud
stages.description: Isolated, privacy-compliant AI compute clusters ensuring localized processing for strategic and defense datasets.

stages.label: STAGE 04
stages.title: Edge Ground-Station Processing
stages.description: Ultra-low latency inference directly deployed at satellite ground station datacenters for time-critical alerts.

stages.label: STAGE 05
stages.title: Downstream Risk & Yield Engines
stages.description: Actionable risk modeling, automated yield forecasting, and damage detection for enterprise workflows.

infrastructureNote.description: Built for scale with strict tech sovereignty, high availability, and institutional-grade data privacy.
